messages:
Lina: quick preflight note: mobile streaming clients hit a burst of 422s against /v2/stream in staging slice-3. It's localized to SDK versions 1.4.x and 1.5.x (mobile-android). Can we carve those tenants out and pin to v1 for the rollout tonight? :iphone:

deploy-bot: Upcoming deploy scheduled: v2.4.0 -> region-us-west in 20m. Plan: staged slices 5%/20%/60%/100%. No tenant pins currently. :robot_face:

Jorge: saw the 422 trace earlier. It looks like chunk boundary handling in the streaming proxy causes an early body-parse reject for specific client-side framing. Not a server model regression, more a transport quirk. Pin makes sense.

Sam: agreed. We should keep the rest of the slice moving. Which tenants are affected?

Lina: affected tenant set = tenant-101, tenant-202, tenant-303 (mobile-android shipping 1.4/1.5). I suggest pin until 2026-03-23T05:00:00Z while we patch the proxy + SDK fix.

Priya: ops question: what's our rollback threshold if other tenants start seeing 422s? I'd rather unpin and pause than rollback full region.

Jorge: propose rollback criteria in runbook addendum for this rollout:
- If global 4xx spike >2% sustained for 5m AND correlated with /v2/stream path -> pause and pin more tenants
- If global 5xx >0.5% for 3m -> full rollback to previous model binary
We will prefer pause + pin over full rollback where possible.

Sam: How do we apply the pin? I can run deploy-bot commands if someone confirms.

Lina: go ahead, please run both in one confirmed message so deploy-bot applies atomically.

Sam: /deploybot pin --tenants tenant-101,tenant-202,tenant-303 --reason "staging streaming 422 mobile-android" --until 2026-03-23T05:00:00Z

deploy-bot: Pin request received: tenant-101, tenant-202, tenant-303. Please confirm with a single message listing tenants to execute. :eyes:

Lina: confirming now.

Lina: /deploybot confirm-pin tenant-101,tenant-202,tenant-303 --note "hold for transport fix"

deploy-bot: Pins applied: tenant-101, tenant-202, tenant-303 -> pinned to v1 until 2026-03-23T05:00:00Z. Action ID: a5d7c3. Proceeding with rollout for remaining slice targets.

Priya: putting a short alert on the stream-path dashboard for extra ops-eyes. Will mute noisy mobile SDK alerts to avoid noise.

Jorge: logging snippet from the hit cluster (for triage):
```
[2026-03-22T02:10:11Z] proxy: parse_error chunk-unexpected-boundary tenant=tenant-101 req=zz9f path=/v2/stream
[2026-03-22T02:10:11Z] http 422 tenant=tenant-101 upstream=ok latency=120ms
```

Sam: docs note: Can someone add a short blurb to the v2 rollout FAQ: "If you use mobile SDKs older than 1.6, we recommend waiting to migrate to v2 streaming due to chunk framing differences. See SDK update notes."

Lina: I'll open a tiny docs PR and reference the pin action ID.

Priya: monitoring -> slice progressing, p95 and error rates unchanged for non-pinned tenants. No further action from ops.

Jorge: follow-up plan: runtime team will patch streaming proxy in next hotfix (deploy slot tomorrow), SDK team will cut 1.6.0 with fix and we will unpin tenants post-validation. If unpin shows >2x p95 for 10m, re-pin and open hotfix rollback.

Lina: closing this thread: pins applied, remaining rollout proceeded, ops on watch. Will update once SDK/patch lands. :white_check_mark:
